name: SimpleOrderPanel
summary: A GUI order panel for MetaTrader that provides manual trading buttons (Buy/Sell, Close All, Close Buy/Sell, Breakeven, Partial Close, Modify SL/TP) and pending order placement via chart click. It supports risk-based lot calculation (balance percentage or fixed lots) and persists settings across sessions using global variables.
summary_zh: 一个MetaTrader图形化下单面板，提供手动交易按钮（买入/卖出、全部平仓、分类平仓、保本、部分平仓、修改止损/止盈）以及通过图表点击设置挂单。支持基于风险的仓位计算（余额百分比或固定手数），并通过全局变量在会话间持久化设置。
strategy_analysis: 这不是一个自动交易策略EA，而是一个半自动交易工具面板。它不产生自己的交易信号，所有入场决策完全由交易者手动做出。入场条件由用户点击买入/卖出按钮触发，或者通过点击图表设置挂单价格。出场条件包括一键平仓全部仓位、分类平仓（仅平多或仅平空）、止损移至保本价位、部分平仓功能。仓位管理支持两种模式：固定手数模式和基于账户余额百分比的动态手数计算，后者根据止损距离和风险百分比自动计算合适的手数。资金管理通过NormalizeLots函数确保手数符合经纪商的最小/最大/步长限制。止损和止盈支持价格模式或距离模式，并可设置自动联动比例关系。
strategy_analysis_en: This is not an automated trading strategy EA but rather a semi-automated trading utility panel. It does not generate its own trading signals; all entry decisions are entirely made manually by the trader. Entry conditions are triggered by the user clicking Buy/Sell buttons or by clicking on the chart to set pending order prices. Exit conditions include one-click close all positions, directional close (close buys or close sells only), moving stop loss to breakeven, and partial close functionality. Position sizing supports two modes: fixed lots mode and dynamic lot calculation based on account balance percentage, where the latter automatically calculates appropriate lot size based on stop loss distance and risk percentage. Money management ensures lot sizes comply with broker minimum/maximum/step constraints via the NormalizeLots function. Stop loss and take profit support both price mode and distance mode, with an optional auto-linked ratio relationship between them.

pros: 界面功能丰富，提供买入/卖出/平仓/保本/部分平仓/挂单等完整交易操作，大幅提升手动交易效率
支持余额百分比风险计算模式，可自动根据止损距离计算仓位大小，有助于控制每笔交易风险
同时兼容MQL5和MQL4，通过宏定义抽象平台差异，具有良好跨平台兼容性
面板位置和设置通过全局变量持久化，重启后自动恢复，用户体验友好
模块化按钮显示控制，用户可按需启用/禁用功能区域，界面简洁灵活
pros_en: Rich UI with complete trading operations (buy/sell/close/breakeven/partial close/pending orders), greatly improving manual trading efficiency
Supports balance percentage risk calculation mode that automatically calculates position size based on stop loss distance, helping control per-trade risk
Compatible with both MQL5 and MQL4 via macro-based platform abstraction, ensuring good cross-platform compatibility
Panel position and settings persist via global variables, auto-restoring after restart for a user-friendly experience
Modular button visibility controls allow users to enable/disable feature zones as needed, keeping the interface clean and flexible
cons: 需要修改标准库Dialog.mqh的私有变量才能解决编译问题，增加维护负担且每次终端更新都会被覆盖
止损止盈修改功能会同时修改所有符合条件的仓位，缺乏逐笔选择能力，可能造成误操作
部分平仓功能对同一符号所有仓位统一执行，无法选择特定仓位进行部分平仓
挂单设置流程依赖图表点击，但在鼠标移动事件中持续调用ChartRedraw，可能影响图表性能
缺少对交易执行结果的详细反馈机制，错误处理仅通过Print输出，用户可能无法及时感知
cons_en: Requires modifying the standard library Dialog.mqh private variables to fix compilation issues, adding maintenance burden and being overwritten on each terminal update
Stop loss/take profit modification applies to all qualifying positions simultaneously, lacking per-position selection which may cause unintended changes
Partial close executes uniformly on all positions for the same symbol, unable to select specific positions for partial closing
Pending order setup relies on chart clicks and continuously calls ChartRedraw on mouse move events, potentially affecting chart performance
Lacks detailed feedback mechanism for trade execution results; error handling only outputs via Print, which users may not notice in time
improvements: 将Dialog.mqh的修改封装为继承类或补丁文件，避免直接修改标准库，减少终端更新后的维护工作
增加仓位选择功能（如点击列表选择特定仓位），使修改止损止盈和部分平仓操作更加精确可控
添加交易执行结果的视觉反馈（如按钮颜色变化、弹窗提示），替代仅依赖Print日志的错误通知方式
improvements_en: Encapsulate Dialog.mqh modifications as an inherited class or patch file to avoid directly modifying the standard library, reducing maintenance after terminal updates
Add position selection capability (e.g., click-to-select from a list) to make SL/TP modification and partial close operations more precise and controllable
Add visual feedback for trade execution results (e.g., button color changes, popup notifications) instead of relying solely on Print log error notifications

risk_points: 全部平仓和分类平仓按钮可一键关闭所有仓位，误点击风险较高但属于工具本身功能设计
修改止损止盈会批量影响所有符合条件仓位，若affectOtherTrades设为true可能意外修改非本面板仓位
需要修改标准库源码才能解决编译问题，若修改不当可能影响其他EA的正常编译
risk_points_en: Close All and directional close buttons can close all positions with one click, risk of accidental clicks but this is inherent to the tool's design
SL/TP modification batch-affects all qualifying positions; if affectOtherTrades is true it may unintentionally modify non-panel positions
Requires modifying standard library source code to fix compilation issues; improper modifications may affect other EAs' compilation
